reason: The README clearly describes an agent-facing browser automation plugin that controls Chrome through CDP for navigation, screenshots, diagnostics, JavaScript evaluation, and mobile emulation; its login-state reuse and arbitrary page scripting justify elevated risk.

summaries.zh: 通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 驱动浏览器，支持导航、截图、页面错误采集、移动端仿真和页面 JavaScript 执行。
summaries.en: Controls Chrome through the Chrome DevTools Protocol for navigation, screenshots, page diagnostics, mobile emulation, and in-page JavaScript evaluation.

capabilities: Launches and controls a Chrome instance through CDP
Navigates to URLs and captures screenshots
Collects console, page, and network errors
Executes arbitrary JavaScript expressions in web pages
Copies browser login-state data into an isolated profile for reuse
Supports mobile viewport and user-agent emulation
Can terminate the controlled browser instance
